Public immutable source-input fixtures, never imported or executed.

The original seven .txt files preserve the three PR177 project API inputs, its project
documentation, plus the three
PR178 controller/doc inputs that this additive change modifies. The remaining
unchanged reference files are read directly by the source tests. Fixed baseline
hashes identify API lineage, not the active later implementation. The Node
controller's original13-pin lineage and desktop controller's9-pin PR178 lineage
remain distinct. Active project preparation separately pins its actual current
import closure; no historical snapshot is represented as proof of current
runtime/source qualification. No private fixtures, grading oracle, account,
installed executable or generated response is included here.

An eighth snapshot, project-entrypoint.mjs.txt, preserves the exact PR177
entrypoint bytes when later optional receipt-saving integration changes the live
entrypoint. The existing controller test reads this snapshot against its original
4127-byte/SHA-256 pin; the historical pin and every controller assertion remain
unchanged. This fixture maintenance does not qualify or authorize native work.
